name: confinamiento-arizona-history-validation
description: Sistema local de gestion para Confinamiento Arizona

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/calculations.unit.test.mjs tests/dayRollover.unit.test.mjs tests/desktopPackaging.unit.test.mjs tests/feedingLayout.unit.test.mjs tests/history.unit.test.mjs tests/reportHistory.unit.test.mjs tests/permissions.unit.test.mjs tests/roles.render.test.mjs tests/license.unit.test.mjs tests/license.render.test.mjs tests/moduleVersions.unit.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/domain/permissions.js --test-coverage-include=src/domain/license.js --test-coverage-include=src/domain/calculations.js --test-coverage-include=src/domain/dayRollover.js --test-coverage-include=src/domain/reportHistory.js --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 tests/calculations.unit.test.mjs tests/dayRollover.unit.test.mjs tests/reportHistory.unit.test.mjs tests/permissions.unit.test.mjs tests/license.unit.test.mjs
